# Token

`schemas/records/token.json`

A bearer token bound to one actor (docs/design/m0/04 "Actors and tokens"). The secret is shown once, at issue, and never stored: the record keeps only its argon2id hash, in the PHC string format. The bearer presents tok_&lt;id&gt;.&lt;secret&gt;; the id finds this record and the hash verifies the secret.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [TokenID](common-defs.md#tokenid) |  |
| `actor` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `hash` | yes | string (pattern `^\$argon2id\$v=19\$m=[1-9][0-9]{0,6},t=[1-9][0-9]{0,2},p=[1-9][0-9]{0,2}\$[A-Za-z0-9+/]{21}[AQgw]\$[A-Za-z0-9+/]{42}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]$`) | argon2id over the secret: $argon2id$v=19$m=&lt;KiB&gt;,t=&lt;passes&gt;,p=&lt;lanes&gt;$&lt;salt&gt;$&lt;key&gt;, a 16-byte salt and a 32-byte key in canonical base64 without padding. internal/identity also requires the cost within its bounds and m &gt;= 8p (RFC 9106). |
| `created_by` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `created_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |
| `revoked_at` | yes | null or [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
